page: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E5.Flex.126-1008 is a large-scale general-purpose virtual machine configuration built on the x86_64 architecture. The instance allocates 126 dedicated physical cores and 252 vCPUs powered by AMD EPYC 9J14 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.3 GHz. Memory capacity totals 1008.0 GB, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Network connectivity includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The VM.Standard.E5.Flex.126-1008 configuration includes no integrated local storage and features zero GPUs, requiring deployments to use network-attached block volumes for disk I/O and persistence. The reliance on dedicated AMD EPYC cores provides predictable multi-threaded CPU execution without core sharing or thread contention. Because local NVMe storage is absent, architectures requiring high-throughput, low-latency disk operations must provision appropriate block volume performance tiers to avoid storage bottlenecks.

With massive multi-core concurrency and over a terabyte of memory, the instance delivers high compute and memory density on a single virtual host. This profile is engineered for horizontally and vertically scaled enterprise workloads that do not require GPU acceleration, such as large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, extensive CI/CD build environments, batch data processing, and consolidated web application fleets.
description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure VM.Standard.E5.Flex.126-1008 is an x86_64 general-purpose virtual machine offering substantial compute density and system memory. Driven by AMD EPYC 9J14 processors running at 2.3 GHz, it provides 126 dedicated physical cores and 252 vCPUs alongside 1008.0 GB of RAM, sustaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The instance does not include discrete GPUs and features no local storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for operating system disks and persistent data. Network connectivity includes a single complimentary public IPv4 address. With extensive multi-threading capacity and a terabyte-scale memory pool, VM.Standard.E5.Flex.126-1008 delivers consistent resource allocation without noisy-neighbor contention on dedicated hardware. This configuration is engineered for demanding enterprise application tiers, large relational database engines, intensive compilation pipelines, in-memory data processing, and large-scale microservice consolidation.
